scoring_defects.question: ledger-lifecycle
scoring_defects.identified: Before answer inspection and scoring; see pre-score-audit.json
scoring_defects.problem: Gold requires raw YAML date quotes unavailable as KG anchors. Dates and task-version facts were nevertheless all correct.

scoring_defects.question: unknown-approval
scoring_defects.problem: Gold only accepts the older pending-approval note. Both agents instead cite the newer explicit statement that final production approval is not recorded; these are valid source-backed answers.

interpretation: Both arms have all 14 canonical factual answers correct, correct abstention, and valid exact source quotes. Frozen full passes remain KG12/14 and Markdown13/14; the differences are citation-rule defects, not observed factual mistakes. No retrospective gold replacement or regrading was performed.
limitations: One run per arm on templated synthetic data, not real personal work.
Project-named source paths make the relevant subset cheap to select.
KG-only versus Markdown-only tools does not measure the marginal benefit of adding KG tools to an agent that retains Markdown access.
Both used shared benchmark lossless paging; results are not a corpus-size-only comparison against the unpaged small trial.
